<!--
Animated CareRelay architecture (README version). Each <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="N">
is one click. To change the design: move/rename cards, re-point edge paths, and keep each
packet's <mpath href> matching an edge path id. Colours come from theme.scss variables.
-->

```{=html}
<svg class="arch" viewBox="0 0 1600 760" role="img" aria-label="CareRelay agent architecture">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#8b9097"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Stage labels -->
  <text class="stage" x="20" y="70">INPUTS</text>
  <text class="stage fragment" data-fragment-index="1" x="330" y="70">STAGE 1 · PARALLEL</text>
  <text class="stage fragment" data-fragment-index="2" x="700" y="70">STAGE 2 · MERGE</text>
  <text class="stage fragment" data-fragment-index="3" x="1060" y="70">STAGE 3 · ACT</text>
  <text class="stage fragment" data-fragment-index="5" x="1400" y="70">OUTPUT</text>

  <!-- Step 0: inputs -->
  <g class="input">
    <rect class="card" x="20" y="125" width="230" height="80" rx="10"/>
    <text class="title" x="40" y="160">Lab results</text>
    <text class="sub" x="40" y="186">PDF</text>
    <rect class="card" x="20" y="315" width="230" height="80" rx="10"/>
    <text class="title" x="40" y="350">Imaging</text>
    <text class="sub" x="40" y="376">report PDF · X-ray</text>
    <rect class="card" x="20" y="505" width="230" height="80" rx="10"/>
    <text class="title" x="40" y="540">Medical history</text>
    <text class="sub" x="40" y="566">PCP summary · questionnaire</text>
    <rect class="card" x="20" y="640" width="230" height="80" rx="10"/>
    <text class="title" x="40" y="675">Insurance card</text>
    <text class="sub" x="40" y="701">image · coverage</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Step 1: three specialists in parallel -->
  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1">
    <g class="edge">
      <path id="e-lab" d="M250 165 H326" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <path id="e-img" d="M250 355 H326" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <path id="e-hist" d="M250 545 H326" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    </g>
    <circle class="packet" r="5"><animateMotion dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#e-lab"/></animateMotion></circle>
    <circle class="packet" r="5"><animateMotion dur="1.6s" begin="0.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#e-img"/></animateMotion></circle>
    <circle class="packet" r="5"><animateMotion dur="1.6s" begin="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#e-hist"/></animateMotion></circle>

    <rect class="card" x="330" y="110" width="280" height="110" rx="10"/>
    <rect x="330" y="110" width="7" height="110" rx="3" fill="var(--violet)"/>
    <text class="title" x="355" y="148">Lab Agent</text>
    <text class="sub" x="355" y="174">values vs reference ranges</text>
    <text class="mono" x="355" y="200">→ flags · incidental</text>

    <rect class="card" x="330" y="300" width="280" height="110" rx="10"/>
    <rect x="330" y="300" width="7" height="110" rx="3" fill="var(--blue)"/>
    <text class="title" x="355" y="338">Radiology Agent</text>
    <text class="sub" x="355" y="364">findings vs impression</text>
    <text class="mono" x="355" y="390">→ findings · incidental</text>

    <rect class="card" x="330" y="490" width="280" height="110" rx="10"/>
    <rect x="330" y="490" width="7" height="110" rx="3" fill="var(--amber)"/>
    <text class="title" x="355" y="528">History Agent</text>
    <text class="sub" x="355" y="554">conditions · meds · allergies</text>
    <text class="mono" x="355" y="580">→ HistoryProfile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Step 2: merge -->
  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="2">
    <g class="edge">
      <path id="e-lab-sum" d="M610 165 H655 V320 H696" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <path id="e-img-sum" d="M610 355 H696" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <path id="e-hist-sum" d="M610 545 H655 V410 H696" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    </g>
    <circle class="packet" r="5"><animateMotion dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#e-lab-sum"/></animateMotion></circle>
    <circle class="packet" r="5"><animateMotion dur="1.8s" begin="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#e-img-sum"/></animateMotion></circle>
    <circle class="packet" r="5"><animateMotion dur="1.8s" begin="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#e-hist-sum"/></animateMotion></circle>

    <rect class="card" x="700" y="250" width="280" height="225" rx="10"/>
    <rect x="700" y="250" width="7" height="225" rx="3" fill="var(--teal)"/>
    <text class="title" x="725" y="290">Summarize</text>
    <text class="sub" x="725" y="316">merge · critic pass</text>
    <text class="sub" x="725" y="340">expected vs incidental</text>
    <rect class="ledger" x="725" y="365" width="230" height="86" rx="8"/>
    <text class="ledger-text" x="740" y="390">INCIDENTAL LEDGER</text>
    <text class="ledger-text" x="740" y="414">• 9 mm lung nodule</text>
    <text class="ledger-text" x="740" y="436">• coronary Ca (findings only)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Step 3: wellness while waiting -->
  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="3">
    <g class="edge">
      <path id="e-sum-well" d="M980 300 H1020 V165 H1056" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    </g>
    <circle class="packet" r="5"><animateMotion dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#e-sum-well"/></animateMotion></circle>
    <rect class="card" x="1060" y="110" width="270" height="110" rx="10"/>
    <rect x="1060" y="110" width="7" height="110" rx="3" fill="var(--orange)"/>
    <text class="title" x="1085" y="148">Wellness Agent</text>
    <text class="sub" x="1085" y="174">nutrition · physio · OTC</text>
    <text class="mono" x="1085" y="200">filtered by allergies, meds</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Step 4: next steps negotiates with insurance -->
  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="4">
    <g class="edge">
      <path id="e-sum-next" d="M980 420 H1020 V435 H1056" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <path id="e-card-ins" d="M250 680 H1056" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <path id="e-next-ins" d="M1165 490 V621" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <path id="e-ins-next" d="M1225 625 V494" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <text class="label" x="700" y="670">card image · member ID</text>
      <text class="label" x="1060" y="563" text-anchor="end">in-network?</text>
      <text class="label" x="1238" y="563">re-propose</text>
    </g>
    <circle class="packet" r="5"><animateMotion dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#e-sum-next"/></animateMotion></circle>
    <circle class="packet" r="5"><animateMotion dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#e-card-ins"/></animateMotion></circle>
    <circle class="packet" r="5"><animateMotion dur="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#e-next-ins"/></animateMotion></circle>
    <circle class="packet" r="5"><animateMotion dur="1.4s" begin="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#e-ins-next"/></animateMotion></circle>

    <rect class="card" x="1060" y="380" width="270" height="110" rx="10"/>
    <rect x="1060" y="380" width="7" height="110" rx="3" fill="var(--magenta)"/>
    <text class="title" x="1085" y="418">Next Steps</text>
    <text class="sub" x="1085" y="444">specialty map · scheduling</text>
    <text class="mono" x="1085" y="470">known specialists first</text>

    <rect class="card" x="1060" y="625" width="270" height="110" rx="10"/>
    <rect x="1060" y="625" width="7" height="110" rx="3" fill="var(--slate)"/>
    <text class="title" x="1085" y="663">Insurance Agent</text>
    <text class="sub" x="1085" y="689">plan · network · cost</text>
    <text class="mono" x="1085" y="715">referral · prior auth</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Step 5: patient-facing result -->
  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="5">
    <g class="edge">
      <path id="e-well-pt" d="M1330 165 H1365 V320 H1396" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <path id="e-next-pt" d="M1330 435 H1365 V420 H1396" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    </g>
    <circle class="packet" r="5"><animateMotion dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#e-well-pt"/></animateMotion></circle>
    <circle class="packet" r="5"><animateMotion dur="1.6s" begin="0.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#e-next-pt"/></animateMotion></circle>
    <g class="patient">
      <rect class="card" x="1400" y="270" width="185" height="200" rx="12"/>
      <text class="title" x="1420" y="312">Patient</text>
      <text class="title" x="1420" y="340">result</text>
      <text class="sub" x="1420" y="375">plain-language</text>
      <text class="sub" x="1420" y="398">summary</text>
      <text class="sub" x="1420" y="430">proposed appts</text>
      <text class="sub" x="1420" y="453">· human confirms</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
```

::: {.captions}
[Four uploads from one patient: labs, imaging, history and an insurance card.]{.caption .fragment .fade-out fragment-index=1}
[**Lab, Radiology and History** read in parallel. Each flags what looks incidental.]{.caption .fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=1}
[**Summarize** merges them. History decides what is *expected*; the rest goes on the incidental ledger.]{.caption .fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=2}
[**Wellness** offers budget nutrition, physio and OTC options while the patient waits.]{.caption .fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=3}
[**Next Steps and Insurance** trade proposals until every follow-up is in network and affordable.]{.caption .fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=4}
[One patient-facing result. **Appointments stay proposed until a human confirms.**]{.caption .fragment fragment-index=5}
:::
